question: Which of the following won the maximum number of total medals in the National Games 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Maharashtra emerged as the overall champion at the **National Games 2023, winning a total of 228 medals: 80 gold, 69 silver, and 79 bronze.**
 
• The** Services team**, which had won the last four editions of the Games **finished second **with 126 medals: 66 gold, 27 silver, and 33 bronze.
 
• **Haryana secured the third position** with 192 medals, including 62 gold, 55 silver, and 75 bronze.
 
• Srihari Nataraj, an Olympic swimmer, was named the best male athlete, with a haul of 8 gold, 1 silver, and 1 bronze.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **First National Games**: Held in **1924 in Lahore,** British India, originally called the Indian Olympic Games.
 
• The National Games are held every few years, though they have faced several delays due to logistical and other challenges.
 
• Hosted by Goa from **October 26 to November 9, 2023**, marking the first time the state hosted the event
 
• The National Games feature a wide variety of sports, including athletics, swimming, wrestling, shooting, gymnastics, and more, covering both Olympic and non-Olympic sports.
 
• **Maharashtra won** the highest number of medals (228), topping the medal tally after a **gap of 29 years**
 
• The Services team dominated the National Games for four consecutive editions before losing the top spot in 2023
 
• Srihari Nataraj (swimmer) and Sanyukta Prasen Kale (gymnast) were standout performers at the 2023 Games​
 
• The modern version of the Games restructured and named the National Games, began in 1985 in New Delhi.
 
• **Goa, the host state in 2023,** performed well, **finishing 9th with 27 gold, 27 silver, and 38 bronze medals**
 
• The National Games serve as a platform for talent identification, promoting sportsmanship and preparing athletes for international competitions like the Olympics.
